description: This file defines a FreeMarker template transform class named CsrfTokenPairNonAjaxTransform. It is responsible for generating CSRF tokens for non-AJAX requests within the OFBiz framework, integrating with Freemarker templates to inject CSRF tokens into responses.

classes.name: CsrfTokenPairNonAjaxTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker TemplateTransformModel implementation that generates a CSRF token for non-AJAX requests and injects it into the template output.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates a Writer that captures template output, accessing the current environment and request to generate and insert CSRF tokens.
